synopsis: Seamus Logan is the Scottish National Party MP for Aberdeenshire North and Moray East, and has been an MP continually since 4 July 2024. He currently undertakes the roles of Shadow SNP Spokesperson (Environment, Food and Rural Affairs), and Shadow SNP Spokesperson (Health and Social Care).
